owner: Linda Hawley and the CHOICES team
summary: A Toronto hygiene practice with 33 years of experience appears to lose new clients to a free builder address, a 2017 date and a gmail contact.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: Clients check a practitioner's credibility online first, and a free builder address looks temporary after 33 years of experience.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a professional email.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say 2017 by CHOICES Dental Hygiene Care, created with Wix.com.
findings.cost: An old date and a builder credit make a visitor wonder if the page is still active.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a gmail address and one phone number, with no text option.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust, and clients who want a quick answer have nothing faster than a call.
findings.fix: A professional email and a one tap text button.
